live_timing: Six paired arms launched concurrently; immediate successive calls, no simulated idle sleeps.
cache_scenario_scope: Counterfactual message-prefix cache at 300/1800 seconds using real measured input/output totals, SHA256 source-prefix matches and explicit 128-token framing guard. Not measured native cache savings.
runtime: Fresh ephemeral subscription thread per request, documented developerInstructions snapshot with quoted evidence; small fixed user task. All actual model usage is measured; native cache behavior is not the target cache model.
baseline: OpenCode source-derived compaction adapter, not native executable
context_basis: Full installed Codex usable window 828400; requested maximum 872000. API Luna full context 1050000 unavailable through this subscription surface.
workaround: User authorized subscription workaround; thread/start developerInstructions snapshot avoids turn/start text-size limitation. No API requests.
policy_scope: Original 0.4.0 selected policy and profile, not refitted on expanded corpus or test results.
sampling: Company IDs fixed before the first policy evaluation; selected from original retrieval-size strata. They are not extrema of the revised full distribution.
comparison: Three distinct unseen-company conversations; not three stochastic repeats of one case.
stop_rule: A denied Compache admission stops that arm without sending a model request; unexecuted turns remain in the coverage denominator. No full-thread savings claim for incomplete pairs.
